entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child with neck-length short brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls, riding Vehicle A with their back to the camera.

entities.name: Vehicle A

entities.name: orange-brown geometric-patterned carpet

entities.name: interior wall

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The dark brown group of doors on both sides and at the end of the corridor, with brass-colored handles visible on some doors.

entities.name: ceiling

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The white circular ceiling light partially visible at the top edge of the image.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The light-colored rectangular framed picture high on the right wall, with a narrow dark outer frame.

entities.name: potted plant at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: The green potted plant to the image-left of the end door at the end of the corridor, with a terracotta-colored round pot at the bottom.

entities.name: red wall plate at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: The two red disc-shaped objects arranged vertically on the far wall, with the upper one larger.
